title: Verify that if the file contains more than mandatory columns than that file should not processed.
preconditions:
1.URL must be working
2.user should be on FMS home page

steps.action: Go to Extraction & Load Layer -> Column Configuration
steps.expectedResult: User should redirect to the list page
Pop up window for file upload should open

steps.action: Now upload the file which contains only more  than three columns
